meta.label: Load Event Server History
meta.description: Import historical event-server files from a managed folder for a single node with an explicit Pulse instance-name mapping.

params.name: folder_id
params.label: Managed Folder ID
params.description: Managed folder id containing exported event-server history files.

params.name: node_id
params.label: Event Server Node ID
params.description: Exact event-server node directory name to import, for example node-mazzei_designer.

params.name: instance_name
params.label: Instance Name Mapping
params.description: Pulse instance name to map this node to, for example mazzei_designer.

params.name: start_date
params.label: Start Date
params.description: Optional lower bound for history import.

params.name: end_date
params.label: End Date
params.description: Optional upper bound for history import.
